# Brain Repository — Cloud Models, Embedding Pipeline, Multimodal, Storage, Memory & Local Support

## 1. Cloud Model/Provider Dependencies

### Gemini embeddings (the embedding pipeline)

The embedding client lives at **src/lib/embedding.ts**. Key facts:

- **Default model:** `gemini-embedding-2-preview` (src/lib/embedding.ts:28)
- **Default dimensions:** 768 (`DEFAULT_DIMS = 768; // Matryoshka: 768 for pgvector compat`, src/lib/embedding.ts:29)
- **Task types supported:** `RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT`, `RETRIEVAL_QUERY`, `SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY`, `CLASSIFICATION`, `CLUSTERING`, `QUESTION_ANSWERING`, `FACT_VERIFICATION`, `CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY` (src/lib/embedding.ts:18-26)
- **V2 task prefix handling:** `gemini-embedding-2*` models require task instructions embedded as text prefixes rather than the `taskType` field (src/lib/embedding.ts:36-38)
- **API endpoint:** `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:embedContent?key={apiKey}` (src/lib/embedding.ts:142)
- **Batch endpoint:** `...batchEmbedContents...` (src/lib/embedding.ts:215)
- **L2 normalization for Matryoshka truncation:** when `dims < 3072`, embeddings are L2-normalized (src/lib/embedding.ts:182-184)
- **Config defaults:** `embeddings.model` = `gemini-embedding-2-preview` (src/lib/brain-config.ts:91), `embeddings.dims` = 768 (src/lib/brain-config.ts:97)

### Gemini LLM calls (auto-kb, rlmx)

**src/auto-kb/gemini.ts** wraps the `@google/generative-ai` SDK:

- Pricing for `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` at 15c/1M input (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:43)
- Reads `GEMINI_API_KEY` from env (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:67)
- `createCachedContent` defaults to model `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:91)
- `generateContent` defaults to model `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:146)

### rlmx usage and model defaults

The **rlmx SDK** (`@automagik/rlmx`) is used in several places:

- **src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts** — opt-in rlmx SDK bridge; model ID defaults to `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts:131). Toggle via `BRAIN_USE_RLMX_SDK=1` env or `rlmx_mode: true` in agent.yaml (src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts:10-12)
- **src/agent/runner.ts** — `runTriageLive` defaults to provider `google` and model `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/agent/runner.ts:138-139)
- **src/lib/analyze.ts** — provider/model default: `{ provider: "google", model: "gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview" }` (src/lib/analyze.ts:259)
- **src/lib/rlmx-config.ts** — generates rlmx.yaml with `provider: google` and `model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/lib/rlmx-config.ts:53-55)
- **src/lib/ask-pipeline.ts** — embeds the RLMX SDK directly; `RLMX_API_KEY_ENV_MAP` lists 13 provider env keys: `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GROQ_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `KIMI_API_KEY`, `MOONSHOT_API_KEY`, `MINIMAX_API_KEY`, `ZAI_API_KEY`, `GLM_API_KEY` (src/lib/ask-pipeline.ts:57-71)

### Env vars required

| Env var | File:line | Usage |
|---------|-----------|-------|
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | src/lib/embedding.ts:94 | Embedding API key |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | src/lib/embedding.ts:94 | Embedding API key fallback |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:67 | Gemini LLM calls |
| `BRAIN_VISION_MODEL` | src/lib/processors/image.ts:61 | Vision model override |
| `GEMINI/GOOGLE_API_KEY` | src/lib/processors/image.ts:49 | Vision API key |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` etc. | src/lib/ask-pipeline.ts:57-71 | rlmx provider keys |
| `BRAIN_USE_RLMX_SDK` | src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts:83 | rlmx SDK toggle |
| `BRAIN_MEMORY_MCP_URL` | src/lib/memory-sense/lifecycle.ts:26 | Mnemosyne organ URL |
| `BRAIN_DATA_DIR` | src/lib/pgserve.ts:75 | Deployment-mode hint |

Also: `src/lib/doctor.ts:18` confirms GEMINI_API_KEY env or `~/.secrets/gemini.key`.

### Anthropic/OpenAI/Google API usage

Brain's own code is **Gemini-only** (Google API). The rlmx SDK and ask-pipeline's key map (src/lib/ask-pipeline.ts:57-71) support Anthropic, OpenAI, Groq, xAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, Moonshot, MiniMax, Z.ai, GLM — injected into env for rlmx/pi-ai.

## 2. Embedding Pipeline

### Implementation file

**src/lib/embedding.ts** implements: `embedText()` (line 109), `embedBatch()` (line 199), `isEmbeddingAvailable()` (line 91), `usesV2TaskPrefix()` (line 36).

### Local/OpenAI-compatible fallback?

**Brain's own embedding path is Gemini-hard-required** — no local/OpenAI fallback. If `embeddings.enabled=false`, embedText returns null (src/lib/embedding.ts:115); if no API key, returns null (src/lib/embedding.ts:133-134). Fallback is BM25+trigram only (src/lib/doctor.ts:253). The **vendored mnemosyne** has local fastembed (memory/mnemosyne/core/embeddings.py:67) and OpenAI-compatible API (lines 60-64).

### embedDims defaults and pgvector

- `DEFAULT_DIMS = 768` (src/lib/embedding.ts:29); brain-config default 768 (src/lib/brain-config.ts:97)
- pgvector schema: migration 021 adds `embedding vector(768)` to brain_documents/chunks/domain_embeddings (src/db/migrations/021-brain-pgvector-retry.sql:53,61,69), HNSW indexes (line 77-78)
- Migration 005 adds `embed_model` default `gemini-embedding-2-preview` and `embed_dims INT DEFAULT 768` (src/db/migrations/005-brain-embeddings.sql:36,41)

## 3. Multimodal Ingestion

Processors in **src/lib/processors/** (TypeScript, not python/):

- **Audio** (audio.ts:2): Groq Whisper (<19.5MB, `tools/ouvir.py`) or Gemini (larger, `tools/ouvir-gemini.py`); selection at line 36
- **Image** (image.ts:2): Gemini Vision via direct fetch(), uses GEMINI/GOOGLE_API_KEY (line 49), model `BRAIN_VISION_MODEL` or default (line 61)
- **PDF** (pdf.ts:2): Gemini via `tools/ler-doc.py`
- **Video** (video.ts:2): ffmpeg audio extraction (line 38), then audio processor (line 44), Gemini Vision via `tools/ver.py` (lines 60-67)

`python/brain_tools.py` is a separate frozen agent tool bridge (search_corpus/propose_yaml/read), not multimodal.

## 4. Storage

### Postgres tables

- **brains** (src/db/migrations/001-brain-foundation.sql:9)
- **brain_documents** (:34)
- **brain_chunks** (:60)
- **khs_memories** (src/db/migrations/022-khortex-mirror.sql:30)
- **brain_memory_meta** (src/db/migrations/026-brain-memory-core.sql:18)
- Plus migrations 006-031 for benchmarks, grade, segments, closed-loop, omni, classification, kv-cache, etc.

### pgserve

**src/lib/pgserve.ts** is a **legacy facade** — "Brain no longer owns a Postgres process" (lines 2-6). `startPgserve()` at line 226 is a deprecated no-op. **src/pgserve.d.ts** declares the pgserve module types.

### Three deployment modes

`src/lib/pgserve.ts:16`: `export type DeploymentMode = "persistent" | "data-dir" | "ephemeral";`
`detectDeploymentMode()` (lines 73-77): `DATABASE_URL` → persistent, `BRAIN_DATA_DIR` → data-dir, else ephemeral.

## 5. Episodic/Session Memory

### Design wishes

**brain-memory-organ** (.genie/wishes/brain-memory-organ/WISH.md:23): "Brain has no session/experience memory" — vendors mnemosyne into `memory/` (line 24-27); Group C adds "Semantic, loudly" (line 37).

**khortex-memory-sense** (.genie/wishes/khortex-memory-sense/WISH.md): senses registry (line 28-39), recall-before/remember-after lifecycle (lines 34-35), "ambient remember ON by default" (line 36, 82). Blocks the episodic->semantic consolidation (line 11).

**memory-consolidation** (.genie/wishes/memory-consolidation/WISH.md): episodic->semantic promotion pipeline (lines 27-40). Episodes silently deleted after **168h trim fuse** (line 30); consolidation creates per-(path,day) digests, hard forget disposal (line 98).

### Memory model

- **Episodic:** mnemosyne organ = standalone k8s SSE MCP service on :8080 (brain/research/memory-systems-lineage.md:30-31). `memory.episodic` sense resolves to `memory_recall`/`memory_remember` tools with hooks (src/lib/senses.ts:127-135).
- **Semantic/consolidation:** memory-consolidation promotes episodes to searchable docs (src/lib/memory-consolidate.ts:619-628), verify-before-dispose.
- **Decay:** 168h trim fuse (memory-consolidation WISH.md:30); scheduler at 24h prevents data loss (line 97).
- **Native port:** `src/lib/brain-memory/` re-exposes 29-tool surface on brain's own Postgres (brain/research/memory-systems-lineage.md:33-34), `vault = brain:<brainId>` (src/lib/brain-memory/store.ts:64-65).

## 6. Local-Model Support

### Brain's own src/

No llama.cpp/Ollama/Lemonade references in `src/`. `residency.ts` describes a "borrow the local model slot" contract (src/lib/residency.ts:4) that is host-agnostic, diverging from the Python reference that hardcodes lemonade (line 11).

### Vendored mnemosyne (memory/)

- **llama-cpp-python** local LLM: "Uses llama-cpp-python (ARM64 + x86_64 native) with ctransformers fallback" (memory/mnemosyne/core/local_llm.py:5); default model `openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B-GGUF` (line 19)
- **Local embeddings via fastembed (ONNX)**: "Supports local fastembed (ONNX) and OpenAI-compatible API embeddings" (memory/mnemosyne/core/embeddings.py:2-3); default `BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` (line 67)
- **OpenAI-compatible embeddings**: `MNEMOSYNE_EMBEDDING_API_KEY`/`MNEMOSYNE_EMBEDDING_API_URL` (memory/mnemosyne/core/embeddings.py:63-64)

### Verdict

Brain's core search is Gemini-only with BM25+trigram fallback. Local models exist only in the vendored mnemosyne memory organ.

## 1. Cloud Model/Provider Dependencies

### Gemini embeddings (the embedding pipeline)

The embedding client lives at **src/lib/embedding.ts**. Key facts:

- **Default model:** `gemini-embedding-2-preview` (src/lib/embedding.ts:28)
- **Default dimensions:** 768 (`DEFAULT_DIMS = 768; // Matryoshka: 768 for pgvector compat`, src/lib/embedding.ts:29)
- **Task types supported:** `RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT`, `RETRIEVAL_QUERY`, `SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY`, `CLASSIFICATION`, `CLUSTERING`, `QUESTION_ANSWERING`, `FACT_VERIFICATION`, `CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY` (src/lib/embedding.ts:18-26)
- **V2 task prefix handling:** `gemini-embedding-2*` models require task instructions embedded as text prefixes rather than the `taskType` field (src/lib/embedding.ts:36-38)
- **API endpoint:** `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:embedContent?key={apiKey}` (src/lib/embedding.ts:142)
- **Batch endpoint:** `...batchEmbedContents...` (src/lib/embedding.ts:215)
- **L2 normalization for Matryoshka truncation:** when `dims < 3072`, embeddings are L2-normalized (src/lib/embedding.ts:182-184)
- **Config defaults:** `embeddings.model` = `gemini-embedding-2-preview` (src/lib/brain-config.ts:91), `embeddings.dims` = 768 (src/lib/brain-config.ts:97)

### Gemini LLM calls (auto-kb, rlmx)

**src/auto-kb/gemini.ts** wraps the `@google/generative-ai` SDK:

- Pricing for `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` at 15c/1M input (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:43)
- Reads `GEMINI_API_KEY` from env (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:67)
- `createCachedContent` defaults to model `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:91)
- `generateContent` defaults to model `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/auto-kb/gemini.ts:146)

### rlmx usage and model defaults

The **rlmx SDK** (`@automagik/rlmx`) is used in several places:

- **src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts** — opt-in rlmx SDK bridge; model ID defaults to `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts:131). Toggle via `BRAIN_USE_RLMX_SDK=1` env or `rlmx_mode: true` in agent.yaml (src/agent/rlmx-bridge.ts:10-12)
- **src/agent/runner.ts** — `runTriageLive` defaults to provider `google` and model `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (src/agent/runner.ts:138-139)
